annotations.title: List Dilution Analyses and When Each Was Rebuilt

description: Paginated list of every company Signal8 holds a dilution analysis for, with when each was last rebuilt, so a re-pull can be timed without a per-company check. Each row: `ticker`, `cik`, `companyName`, `snapshotBuiltAt` (every instrument family was last extracted from filings at or after this instant), `snapshotBuiltPromptVersion` (under at least this extraction version), `lastUpdatedAt` (when the served answer last changed for any reason, including partial updates and float refreshes), `generatedAt` (the latest model pass of any kind, which a partial update moves without a rebuild), `available`, `unavailableReason`, `publication` (published / row_redacted / withheld) and `supersededBy` for a retired symbol. A null build time or version means not known. Filters: `builtSince` and `updatedSince` (ISO date or date-time, inclusive), `minPromptVersion` (numeric compare; rows with an unknown version are excluded), `tickers` (comma-separated, up to 200) and `includeRetired`. Sorted newest first by `sort` (lastUpdatedAt or snapshotBuiltAt), rows with no value last; `pagination.nextCursor` is the next page (null on the last one) and is valid only with the same `sort`. Retired symbols (renamed under the same SEC registrant) are left out unless `includeRetired` is true or the symbol is in `tickers`. A symbol in `tickers` with no analysis of its own (a former symbol, e.g. MULN for BINI) resolves as the per-company tools do: the current symbol's row is returned with `resolvedFrom` {symbol, cik, currentSymbol, via}, also listed in `meta.resolved`. The list carries no instrument data or figures, and is refreshed at most every 5 minutes (`meta.listBuiltAt`); whether a newer filing has been read since a snapshot is only in the per-company coverage check. Returns HTTP 200 for unavailable data: a withheld analysis is listed with `available: false` and its `unavailableReason`, and a company absent from the list (not_covered) has not been analysed yet, which is not the same as having no dilution; an outage is a 5xx. A null, absent or withheld value means the figure was not measured; it does not mean "no dilution", "no warrants", "no shelf" or zero. A numeric 0 is a measured zero, so availability is carried by the availability, withheld and reason fields, not by the value. Included in Signal8 Pro: without it the call returns 403 FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE with `requiredTier: "pro"` (a tier upgrade; there is no add-on to buy).

builtSince.description: Only analyses whose snapshotBuiltAt is at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

includeRetired.description: List retired symbols too (withheld, with supersededBy).

minPromptVersion.description: Only analyses built under at least this extraction version, e.g. 2674.0.

sort.description: Sort key, newest first. Default lastUpdatedAt.

tickers.description: Comma-separated symbols, at most 200. A former symbol resolves to the current one (resolvedFrom).

updatedSince.description: Only analyses whose lastUpdatedAt is at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.
